articles.summary: LOS ANGELES, Calif. — Cadiz, Inc. (NASDAQ: CDZI, CDZIP) (“Cadiz” or the “Company”) today announced the availability of its third-quarter 2026 shareholder letter from Chief Executive Officer Susan Kennedy, with financial commentary from Chief Financial Officer Jacinto Hernandez.
